ved.translation: abbr. vacuum erection device 真空负压勃起装置; vedova (Italian=widow) （意大利语）寡妇

veda.definition: n (from the Sanskrit word for `knowledge') any of the most ancient sacred writings of Hinduism written in early Sanskrit; traditionally believed to comprise the Samhitas, the Brahmanas, the Aranyakas, and the Upanishads
veda.translation: n. 吠陀经；吠陀本集（印度最古老的宗教文献和文学作品的总称）

vedaic.translation: n. 吠陀梵语;早期梵文

vedalia.definition: n native to Australia; introduced elsewhere to control scale insects

vedanga.translation: [网络] 吠陀支；吠陀的六个分支；吠陀之分支

vedanta.definition: n (from the Sanskrit for `end of the Veda') one of six orthodox philosophical systems or viewpoints rooted in the Upanishads as opposed to Mimamsa which relies on the Vedas and Brahmanas
vedanta.translation: n. 吠檀多(古代印度哲学中一直发展至今的唯心主义理论)

vedantic.definition: a. Of or pertaining to the Vedas.

vedantism.translation: n. 吠檀多（印度教的主要哲学） (Vedanta的变形)

vedantist.definition: n. One versed in the doctrines of the Vedantas.
vedantist.translation: n. 吠檀多（印度教的主要哲学）学家 (Vedanta的变形)

vedas.translation: n. 吠陀经（印度最古的宗教文献和文学作品的总称），吠陀本集( Veda的名词复数 )

vedder's culture-medium.translation: [医] 维德氏培养基, 淀粉琼脂

vedder's medium.translation: [医] 维德氏培养基(淀粉琼脂)

vedder's sign.translation: [医] 维德氏征(脚气病的一种体征)

vedding.translation: (ved 的现在分词) abbr. vacuum erection device 真空负压勃起装置; vedova (Italian=widow) （意大利语）寡妇

veddoid.translation:
n. 维多依人（古代南亚人种, 被认为是维达人的祖先）
a. 维多依人的

vedette.definition:
n. A sentinel, usually on horseback, stationed on the outpost
   of an army, to watch an enemy and give notice of danger; a vidette.

vedic.definition: a. of or relating to the Vedas or to the ancient Sanskrit in which they were written
vedic.translation:
n. 吠陀梵语(早期梵文之一种)
a. 吠陀的

vedro.definition:
n. A Russian liquid measure, equal to 3.249 gallons of U. S.
   standard measure, or 2.706 imperial gallons.
